title: Slow down orderbook triangle size changes in cluster heatmap mode

requirements.text: Make the Orderbook Heatmap (cluster/triangle mode) change size more slowly by slowing the transition animation between snapshots and aligning the transition duration with the selected Update Interval (so triangles grow/shrink gradually instead of jumping every ~1s).

quotes: kannst du den Zeitintervall noch ändern, sodaß die dreiecke sich nicht im Sekundentakt ändern sondern langsamer grösser oder kleiner werden.

acceptanceCriteria: When Rendering Mode is set to "Cluster", triangle shape/size changes are visibly smoother and slower (no rapid per-second "jumping") at the default settings.
Transition/animation duration used by the canvas is derived from the currently selected Update Interval (e.g., a large fraction of the interval) and updates immediately when the interval changes.
The polling behavior (snapshot fetch cadence) continues to follow the selected Update Interval; only the visual transition speed is adjusted.

requirements.text: Extend the Update Interval control in the Orderbook Heatmap view with slower options suitable for gradual triangle changes (e.g., add 10s and 15s), and choose a slower default interval so the first experience is not "per-second" updates.

quotes: ...nicht im Sekundentakt ändern sondern langsamer grösser oder kleiner werden.

acceptanceCriteria: The Update Interval dropdown includes additional slow options beyond the current 1s/2s/5s (at minimum: 10s and 15s).
The default Update Interval value in `frontend/src/components/OrderbookHeatmapView.tsx` is set to a slower setting (>= 5s).
All user-facing labels for these options are in English (consistent with the current control labels).

constraints: Do not edit any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or other paths listed in `frontend.immutablePaths`.
Keep the backend architecture unchanged (single Motoko actor); no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Do not change the Hyperliquid API polling endpoint or payload shape.
Do not redesign the heatmap rendering modes (Bars vs Cluster) beyond slowing the perceived change speed.
Do not add real-time streaming/WebSocket updates.
